title: Subregion question resolution and answer report mode recovery
body:
SUBREGION QUESTION UNDERSTANDING
- Specific subregions (such as Southeast Asia, Central Asia, South Asia, East Asia, and European regions) now take priority over broad continent matching in English and Polish.
- Added comprehensive Polish inflections (e.g. "Azji Południowo-wschodniej") and English spelling variants so regional questions evaluate accurately against curated subregion data.
- Fixed diagonal direction matching so regional queries containing directional words are no longer dropped.

ANSWER REPORT ACCURACY & MODE RESOLUTION
- Answer reports now cryptographically verify signed report tokens and automatically resolve the correct game mode if a mismatch occurs.
- Prevents answer reports from inadvertently linking to questions in different game modes.
